title: De novo protein design in an expanded chemical space
authors: Yuxuan Li; Yanbo Jing; Yeyu Su; Wei Ren; Jiayi Zhang; Tao Liu
one_liner_zh: 该文提出CheMoDesign生成框架，在预训练全原子结构预测模型中弱化配对表示并保留化学锚点，结合序列条件去噪，实现含非天然残基和化学修饰的蛋白质从头设计，核心贡献于蛋白质结构生成与设计，方法创新且经实验验证。
abstract: Generative protein design has made sequence and structure programmable, yet its chemical alphabet remains largely confined to the canonical twenty. Here, we establish CheMoDesign, an experimentally validated generative framework for designing proteins de novo around user-specified chemistry. CheMoDesign weakens pair-representation conditioning in a pretrained all-atom structure-prediction model while preserving chemical anchors, then refines generated backbones through sequence-conditioned denoising. By treating post-translational modifications, synthetic residues, and chemical modifications as user-defined building blocks, the framework generated proteins with chemistry-dependent recognition and reactivity in single-round experimental campaigns. Sulfotyrosine and nitrotyrosine enabled modification-dependent recognition of thrombin and HER2, respectively. Genetically encoded noncanonical residues enabled bioorthogonal affinity switching and light- or proximity-triggered covalent target capture. Post-expression chemical modifications yielded a light-activated covalent PD-L1 binder and an isoform-selective CA IX inhibitor (KD = 45 nM) designed to engage catalytic Zn2+;. CheMoDesign makes chemical mechanism a programmable dimension of de novo protein design.
abstract_zh: 生成式蛋白质设计已使序列和结构变得可编程，但其化学字母表仍主要局限于经典的二十种氨基酸。在此，我们建立了CheMoDesign，一个经过实验验证的生成框架，用于围绕用户指定的化学特性从头设计蛋白质。CheMoDesign在预训练的全原子结构预测模型中削弱成对表示的条件约束，同时保留化学锚点，然后通过序列条件去噪精炼生成的骨架。通过将翻译后修饰、合成残基和化学修饰视为用户定义的构建模块，该框架在单轮实验活动中生成了具有化学依赖性识别和反应性的蛋白质。硫酸酪氨酸和硝基酪氨酸分别实现了对凝血酶和HER2的修饰依赖性识别。基因编码的非经典残基实现了生物正交亲和性切换以及光或邻近触发的共价靶标捕获。表达后化学修饰产生了一种光激活的共价PD-L1结合剂和一种设计用于结合催化Zn2+的异构体选择性CA IX抑制剂（KD = 45 nM）。CheMoDesign使化学机制成为从头蛋白质设计的可编程维度。
